basic_info.description: Very special Victorian with 3 bedrooms and 2 full remodeled baths. The upper rear bedroom has a large deck overlooking the tranquil and magical south-facing back yard. The open floor plan has a great redone kitchen with stainless steel appliances- icluding a professional 36" Viking range, quartz countertops, Hardwood and softwood floors, and coved ceilings. Loys of additional room for storage/ home office/ play room/ workshop in the basement. There are some great views of downtown, and a short stroll to Castro, filled with coffee shops, restaurants, and public transportation.
